# Team Up Foundation

> Team Up Foundation is a registered NGO based in Mumbai, India, holding provisional 12A and 80G certification. It designs CSR employee experiences for Indian corporates that pair a celebration for the employees with real, lasting impact for the community at the center of the day. Its working principle: celebration, not charity.

Team Up Foundation is run by two trustees: Nevil Darukhanawala and Arvind Kukreti. It is deliberately explicit about the difference between what it has already delivered and what is still a concept it's building toward — every experience listed below as "delivered" has actually happened; anything else on the site is a concept, clearly marked as such.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://teamupfoundation.org.in/): What Team Up Foundation does, who it works with, and the celebration-plus-impact model.
- [About](https://teamupfoundation.org.in/about): Registration status, the two trustees, how the organisation is structured.
- [How We Celebrate](https://teamupfoundation.org.in/how-we-celebrate): What "celebration" means in practice — not spectacle, but a moment worth telling.
- [Experiences](https://teamupfoundation.org.in/experiences): Every experience Team Up has designed — delivered and concept — browsable in one place.
- [Our Stories](https://teamupfoundation.org.in/stories): The delivered experiences, told in full, with real outcomes.
- [Partner With Us](https://teamupfoundation.org.in/partner): How a CSR or HR team, or another NGO, engages Team Up Foundation.
- [Contact](https://teamupfoundation.org.in/contact): Email, phone, and registered office for reaching the trustees.

## Experiences delivered

- [Dharavi Dreams](https://teamupfoundation.org.in/experiences/dharavi-dreams): A music video made with 13 teenage hip-hop artists from Dharavi, Mumbai, delivered with Rahi Theatre Collaboration and The Dharavi Dream Project. Reached roughly 500,000 organic views.
- [Colors on the Ward](https://teamupfoundation.org.in/experiences/colors-on-the-ward): An art day with Access Life Assistance Foundation for children undergoing cancer treatment. Their artwork is displayed on the Team Up Foundation site.
- [Independence Day Children's Festival](https://teamupfoundation.org.in/experiences/independence-day-childrens-festival): A festival for roughly 300 children, delivered with Giving Tree Foundation and Way of Hope Charitable Trust.

Every other experience on [teamupfoundation.org.in/experiences](https://teamupfoundation.org.in/experiences) (Sunset Sessions, The Little Chefs, Wonder Day, and others) is a concept — an idea Team Up is open to building with the right partner, not something that has happened yet.

## Answers for CSR and HR teams

- [CSR Compliance FAQ](https://teamupfoundation.org.in/blog/csr-faq-hub): Quick answers on Section 135 applicability, CSR-1 registration, unspent funds, and reporting.
- [CSR in India: The Complete Guide](https://teamupfoundation.org.in/blog/csr-pillar-guide): A full walkthrough of CSR compliance for CSR heads and teams.
- [Blog](https://teamupfoundation.org.in/blog): Notes on CSR compliance, employee engagement, and community collaboration in Mumbai.

## Registration

Team Up Foundation is a registered NGO with provisional 12A and 80G certification. Contact the trustees directly for registration numbers and certificates.
